notes.title: Async PVP is LIVE!!
notes.content:
Notes
[list]
[*]Every OTHER battle will pit you against another player's build AND actions
[*]New format: Tug-O-War: PVP matches will follow this format to keep your moves consistent with your opponents
[*]Many Balance changes, NikNaks, curses, and some relics/ spells
[*]3 total lives, losing a PVP fight will not result in a loss, but you will not get loot
[*]5 new relics
[*]curses have been updated to stay relevant for PVP
[*]Triple has been replaced with FILLER, a filler will fill up any empty space until you have at least 8 NikNaks
[/list]

notes.title: Major Playtest Update!
notes.content:
Patch notes:

[b]CORE GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/b]
-The drawing/discarding sytem has been completely revamped... You always have your you max hand size in niknaks, when you attack with a niknak you discard it and draw another
-[b]ASCENDING[/b]- Once per game - you can ascend a niknak... Find out what that means by playing it again [b](MAJOR MECHANIC)[/b]
-CRIT/POISON/BLEED effects have been added. Burn has been added back. ALL of these are incredibly powerful 
-Spells are now more significant, but casting a spell will end your turn, End turn button removed

BOARD/LEVELS
-You can reroll the dice  multiple times, so long as you have the coin
-You can choose which enemy you want for each fight, easy medium or hard, the difficulty will determine the reward
-you can skip a fight entirely, and get an alternative reward, but will not get a free reroll on the board
-To keep things simple, enemies have been modified back to an be even more replaceable, but enemy health scales after each fight significantly (fight 1: 100 health, fight 10: 12500 health)
 -Defensive playstyles have been removed, But health RESETS after fight... You need to be able to deal enough damage with the limit being your health total... 
-you can increase the number of relics you can carry
-you can draft duplicate niknaks

notes.title: Major game redesign update
notes.content:
UPDATE NOTES 
Update Info: 
1-You can play niknaks multiple times, but niknaks now cost spirit to play, niknaks no longer generate essence as an offset.
2- the spell system has been revamped to be cooldowns or consumables, not all spells proc at the same time.
3- DEFENSIVE PLAY- 
   a-we've added a light/dark parrying system for negating enemy damage and dealing damage
   b- Some niknaks have the WEAK intention, which just weakens the enemy
4-  ROUND SYSTEM
Boss fights work a little differently, light attacks target the top lane, dark  attacks target the bottom lane, whoever is winning either lane at the end of the round will deal damage to the other
5-Targeting and attacking is now click based, you choose your target ahead of time, clicking will attack the specified target
6-Ankh is now passive and will heal at the end of each fight and FULLY REVIVE you 1 time. Revive is recharged upon passing the GO space 
7- Burn has been removed (for now) to help with balancing
8- Most niknaks now Proc ON ATTACK rather than requiring triggers
9- 5  ultra diffiuclt post boss fights added
